title: Superscribe
summary: SUPERSCRI'BE, verb transitive [Latin super and scribo, to write.] To write or engrave on the top, outside or surface; or to write the name or address of one on the outside or cover; as, to superscribe

inlines.v: SUPERSCRI'BE, verb transitive [Latin super and scribo, to write.] To write or engrave on the top, outside or surface; or to write the name or address of one on the outside or cover; as, to superscribe a letter.
